name: mast-shared-mount
description: Establish Z: as the unit's OPERATIONAL shared drive -- \\<controller_host>\mast-share on the site control machine -- in the LOCAL SYSTEM logon session. MAST_common's Filer roots its 'shared' area on Z:\MAST\<hostname>\ and the ram-to-shared mover writes every exposure there, and drive letters are per-logon-session, so a mapping made in one logon session is invisible to a process in another (and Filer then silently falls back to C:\MAST). Installs mast-mount-shared.ps1, registers it as a SYSTEM at-startup scheduled task, and clears the stale per-user Z: mappings earlier provisioning runs left pointing at the provisioning server. The startup task is the only mechanism: the nssm Start/Pre hook that used to complement it hung off mast-unit, and no MAST service is registered any more (#159) -- which also means this SYSTEM-session mapping now serves no MAST process, tracked as #173. The share credential is a machine-bound DPAPI-LocalMachine blob written by the driver, never plaintext on disk. Runs at order 2210, right after the mast provider lays down the source tree. Mounting is best-effort (a unit provisioned off-site cannot reach its controller); installing the mechanism is not. See issue #25.
